text:
maria.ops: heads up — FRA staging sent a customs hold on AWB 771-992334. H100 batch 246 marked 'commercial invoice mismatch'.
jorge_nexa: looking into it now. courier flagged declared value vs. invoice. sending corrected docs in ~30m. sorry for the noise. :pray:
alex_k: if customs keeps them another 24h our weekend staging queue will overflow. any chance to re-route to CDG or AMS?
sre-oncall: re-route will add transit time ~48h and extra handling. we can accept at CDG but need advance notice for dock slot and temp power.
maria.ops: can we do split: release portion (12 units) to FRA for immediate top-off, hold the rest for re-route? finance-ledger will need an insurance waiver.
jorge_nexa: vendor can do split. we can create new AWBs: 1x FRA (12 units), 1x AMS air (remaining 36). I'll ask courier for estimated ATP and new AWB numbers.
logistics-bot: MANIFEST SNIPPET:
```
AWB: 771-992334
SKU: H100-48
QTY: 48
BATCH: 246
CLAIM_VALUE_EUR: 2,160,000
```
maria.ops: customs said HS code dispute (they think it's 8471 vs 8542). Jorge, can you provide product spec sheet + ECCN to support 8471 classification?
jorge_nexa: yes — attaching spec and ECCN in email. also pushing a commercial invoice amendment.
finance-ledger: insurance note — current policy covers declared value up to EUR 2M per AWB. If we split and re-declare, we need to confirm coverage for both AWBs or provide top-up. Jorge, can you accept deducting courier surcharge from vendor credit if claim occurs?
jorge_nexa: vendor willing to absorb surcharge up to EUR 6k for this incident, not insurance excess. we'll confirm in writing.
alex_k: operational ask — SRE: if 12 units come to FRA, can we immediately put them into the 'temp-loaner' pool with firmware locked and strict tag so they don't get auto-provisioned to prod? We need them for critical backlog.
sre-oncall: yes, we can reserve and apply a quarantine tag. add to config: `reserve_pool: FRA-temp-loaners; quarantine:true; fw_lock:2026-02-rc1`. ops, please include desired tags in the manifest.
maria.ops: copy that. Jorge, please push the amended invoice ASAP. If AMS AWB estimated arrival is >72h we will escalate to expedite air (cost-share?).
jorge_nexa: noted. will share AWB for FRA within 40m and AMS ETA in the same thread. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
alex_k: one last ask — if customs rejects the classification, we may need to start RMA for any DOA units found on staging. ops, coordinate depot labels and vendor RMA form.
maria.ops: will prep RMA template and staging inspection checklist. leaving note for oncall to monitor.
sre-oncall: I'll watch fleet portal and alert on any DOA flags. set notification to #eng-oncall if more than 2 rejects on arrival.
logistics-bot: UPDATE (40m): courier uploaded amended invoice (ref INV-AMEND-246A) and ECCN doc received. AWB split created: 771-992334 (FRA, 12u), 771-992335 (AMS, 36u).
maria.ops: perfect — thanks. closing loop once FRA confirms release.
